sentences.back: A company made a useful app.
It helps people learn new things.
The app uses large word lists.
These word lists help the app know what to teach.
People give the app words to learn.
This is "training data." The app must be good.
The company must tell people about these words.
This is "disclosure." The app must show how it learns.
This is "transparency." The company must be kind and fair.
They want people to like the app.
